انسكبت (form VII)
# اِنْسَكَبْتُ (insakabtu) /in.sa.kab.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْسَكَبَ (insakaba)
# اِنْسَكَبْتَ (insakabta) /in.sa.kab.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْسَكَبَ (insakaba)
# اِنْسَكَبْتِ (insakabti) /in.sa.kab.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْسَكَبَ (insakaba)
# اِنْسَكَبَتْ (insakabat) /in.sa.ka.bat/: third-person
